text: Dance therapy is a modality of physical exercise that uses movement as a psychotherapeutic tool to promote integration, based on the assumption of interconnection between an individual’s body and mind [ 14 ]. When performed with music, this can become especially motivational [ 15 ]. In this way, dance therapy as a modality of physical exercise can have physiological benefits that improve physical and mental health.
source_label: Effects of dance therapy in women with breast cancer: A systematic review protocol
